data.name: SALUS
data.detailed_description:
A fast-paced turn-based 4X strategy game where four radically different factions compete through diplomacy, politics, exploration, and war.

Every faction features unique mechanics, systems, and even interface design, creating a truly asymmetrical strategy experience where no two playthroughs feel the same.

Built for both veterans and newcomers to the genre, the game delivers deep strategic gameplay in shorter, more approachable sessions without sacrificing complexity.

Four Factions. Four Completely Different Ways to Play.

The XLVth Ironclad Bureau

An industrial expeditionary force from a powerful steampunk empire. Expand across the island, establish profitable colonies, exploit ancient technology, and lead humanity’s race into a new age of discovery.

Perfect for players who enjoy expansion, exploration, and technological domination.

The Devas

Ancient towering automatons created by a lost civilization. Decaying and near extinction, they seek a species capable of restoring them before it is too late.

Mysterious and Powerful but slowly dying. Balance the preservation of their dwindling existence while searching for a way to prevent their extinction.

The Hemicetus Dynasty

The remnants of a once-glorious empire now fractured by decadence and decline. Reclaim lost prestige through politics, calculated expansion, and manipulation.

Designed for players who enjoy slow-burning progression and overwhelming late-game power

The Vulris Federation

Native fox tribes deeply connected to the island and the Devas themselves. Frail individually but strong in numbers, they wield primitive magic, mobility, and superior map knowledge.

Ideal for players who prefer adaptability, guerrilla warfare, and unconventional tactics.
